name: liftoff-function-ts
description: Contract function in TypeScript (FNC-01…06): the behaviour of modules/testing/functions/rust, built with componentize-js.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outfile build/index.js --target browser --format esm --external 'wasi:*' && mkdir -p dist && jco componentize build/index.js --wit ../../../../wit/function --world-name function --out dist/fn_ts.wasm
